<DOCSTRING>
Binds the main execution point of the application, orchestrating the creation and management of user objects.

This class is responsible for initializing the application and managing user data. It creates instances of the User class and passes them to the UserManager for processing. The main method serves as the entry point for the application, demonstrating how to use the User and UserManager classes.

@attribute args (String[]): Command-line arguments passed to the application. Used to initialize user data.
</DOCSTRING>
